item.title: [Tamil Guardian - Tamil Affairs] Remembering the Sencholai massacre 20 years on
item.description:
Remembering the Sencholai massacre 20 years on
by Sharmini
Fri, 14/08/2026 - 07:55
Body
Today marks the 20th anniversary of the massacre of 53 school girls by the Sri Lankan Air Force.
On August 14 2006, four Sri Lankan air force jets flew over the Vanni and dropped sixteen bombs over the Sencholai children's home for orphans, killing 53 school girls and 4 teachers.

item.title: [Daily FT - Front Page] Govt. reopens probe into missing $ 17.79 m legacy Treasury payments
item.description: The Government has reopened investigations into two overseas procurement transactions worth a combined $ 17.79 million, including payments for Australian milch cows and Chinese fertiliser, as part of a broader review of historic public expenditure, Public Security and Parliamentary Affairs Minister Ananda Wijepala told Parliament yesterday.
